# Libraries an AppImage must take from the host, never from its own bundle.
#
# Shipping our own copy of any of these breaks on machines whose system
# libraries are newer: the host's driver stack loads our older copy, misses a
# symbol it needs and fails. That is what turned the window white on Manjaro
# in v0.4.3 and v0.4.4 — the bundled libwayland-client (wayland 1.20) lacked
# three symbols Mesa's EGL driver imports, so eglInitialize failed and the
# renderer aborted.
#
# Vendored from the AppImage community excludelist so builds do not depend on
# a file that can change upstream between releases:
# https://github.com/AppImageCommunity/pkg2appimage/blob/master/excludelist
# Refreshed: 2026-08-10.

ld-linux.so.2
ld-linux-x86-64.so.2
libanl.so.1
libasound.so.2
libBrokenLocale.so.1
libcidn.so.1
libcom_err.so.2
libc.so.6
libdl.so.2
libdrm.so.2
libEGL.so.1
libexpat.so.1
libfontconfig.so.1
libfreetype.so.6
libfribidi.so.0
libgbm.so.1
libgcc_s.so.1
libglapi.so.0
libGLdispatch.so.0
libGL.so.1
libGLX.so.0
libgmp.so.10
libgpg-error.so.0
libharfbuzz.so.0
libICE.so.6
libjack.so.0
libm.so.6
libmvec.so.1
libnss_compat.so.2
libnss_dns.so.2
libnss_files.so.2
libnss_hesiod.so.2
libnss_nisplus.so.2
libnss_nis.so.2
libOpenGL.so.0
libpipewire-0.3.so.0
libpthread.so.0
libresolv.so.2
librt.so.1
libSM.so.6

libusb-1.0.so.0
libutil.so.1

libwayland-client.so.0

libX11-xcb.so.1
libxcb-dri2.so.0
libxcb-dri3.so.0
libxcb.so.1
libz.so.1
